[Intro: bouncing piano riff, handclaps]

[Verse 1: cool distant female voice]
Nine o'clock, the east wall
Noon, the palm, that's all
Three, the far umbrella
I move when the light does

[Chorus: piano riff, full house beat]
I'm chasing shade
Wherever it goes, I go
Dragging my chair across the day
Cool and slow
I'm chasing shade
Funny, it's always where you are

[Drop: piano riff, bass and claps, no vocal]

You sit like the afternoon's enough
I set my towel a little near
It's ten degrees cooler here

[Chorus: piano riff, full house beat]
I'm chasing shade
Wherever it goes, I go
Dragging my chair across the day
Cool and slow
I'm chasing shade
Funny, it's always where you are

East wall. Palm. Umbrella. You.
